papers.title: Superconductivity and local stacking polymorphism in LaNiGa2 thin films
papers.abstract: LaNiGa2 has attracted considerable interest as a candidate unconventional superconductor, particularly due to its reported time-reversal symmetry breaking and nonsymmorphic crystal structure hosting symmetry-protected electronic band degeneracies. Here, we report the growth and characterization of superconducting LaNiGa2 thin films on MgO substrates by magnetron sputtering. X-ray diffraction reveals highly crystalline, (010)-oriented films with well-defined in-plane alignment and rotational twinning. Electrical transport measurements establish superconductivity with a transition temperature of approximately 1 K. Atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy reveals local variations in crystallographic orientation and interlayer stacking, with a predominantly Cmcm structure containing minority Cmmm regions. The coexistence of these closely related structures reveals local stacking polymorphism that is difficult to distinguish using conventional X-ray diffraction. These findings establish a superconducting LaNiGa2 thin-film platform and provide new insight into the local crystal structure of a material whose electronic properties and superconducting pairing remain under active investigation.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；薄膜生长与结构/输运表征；研究对象：MgO衬底上磁控溅射生长的LaNiGa2超导薄膜
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在MgO衬底上获得(010)取向、高度结晶的超导LaNiGa2薄膜，转变温度约1 K，并发现以Cmcm为主相、含少量Cmmm区域的局域堆垛多型。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：能否制备LaNiGa2超导薄膜，并厘清其局域晶体结构与取向、堆垛变化？
证据与比较：X射线衍射显示高度结晶、(010)取向、面内取向明确并存在旋转孪晶；输运测量给出约1 K的超导转变温度；原子分辨透射电镜显示局域取向与层间堆垛变化，主相Cmcm并含少量Cmmm区域。
papers.method_zh: 磁控溅射生长；X射线衍射、电输运测量、原子分辨透射电子显微镜表征。

english_guide.finding: Superconducting LaNiGa2 thin films on MgO are (010)-oriented and highly crystalline, with a transition temperature of approximately 1 K; atomic-resolution TEM reveals local stacking polymorphism with a predominantly Cmcm structure containing minority Cmmm regions.
english_guide.question: Can superconducting LaNiGa2 thin films be grown, and what is their local crystal structure, orientation, and interlayer stacking?
english_guide.evidence: X-ray diffraction shows highly crystalline, (010)-oriented films with well-defined in-plane alignment and rotational twinning; transport measurements establish superconductivity near 1 K; atomic-resolution TEM shows local variations in crystallographic orientation and interlayer stacking.
english_guide.method: Magnetron sputtering growth; X-ray diffraction, electrical transport measurements, and atomic-resolution transmission electron microscopy.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that these findings establish a superconducting LaNiGa2 thin-film platform and provide new insight into local stacking polymorphism difficult to distinguish using conventional X-ray diffraction.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify film thickness, growth parameters, transport measurement conditions, or evidence for superconducting pairing symmetry; local structure conclusions rely on TEM.

papers.title: Coulomb Crystallization in Free Electron Beams
papers.abstract: Classical Coulomb crystals and quantum Wigner crystals typically arise when repulsive interactions order like-charged particles in spatially confined environments. Here, we show that transient crystallization can also emerge in freely propagating electron pulses without external trapping. Experimentally, we use a transmission electron microscope to measure number-resolved energy correlations in photoemitted pulses containing up to nine electrons, revealing strong correlations at small particle numbers that progressively disappear in the pulse interior as the number increases. To explain these observations, we combine many-body simulations with a one-dimensional statistical-mechanical model, showing that the leading and trailing electrons generate a self-induced longitudinal potential that transiently confines the inner particles, enabling the formation of an ordered chain during propagation. The resulting crystallization phase diagram reveals how many-body ordering dynamics can be understood in terms of evolving macroscopic beam properties, namely its geometry and the ratio of the mean Coulomb interaction energy to the longitudinal thermal energy. Extending this framework, we theoretically demonstrate that weak transverse guiding through electrostatic or optical ponderomotive forces can sustain crystallization at larger particle numbers and predict spontaneous longitudinal periodic bunching in continuous electron beams. Our results identify conditions under which stochastic Coulomb interactions can be harnessed to generate self-structured, strongly correlated electron beams in both pulsed and continuous regimes.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论计算混合；依据为透射电镜测量加多体模拟与统计力学模型；研究对象：自由传播的光发射电子脉冲，最多含九个电子，无外部俘获
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 自由传播电子脉冲中可出现瞬态库仑结晶：首尾电子产生自感纵向势，暂时约束内部电子形成有序链。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：无外部空间约束的自由传播电子脉冲中，排斥相互作用能否驱动瞬态有序化，以及该有序化如何随粒子数演化。
证据与比较：用透射电镜测量最多含九个电子的光发射脉冲的数分辨能量关联；小粒子数下呈强关联，随粒子数增加在脉冲内部逐渐消失。
papers.method_zh: 透射电子显微镜数分辨能量关联测量，结合多体模拟与一维统计力学模型，并构建结晶相图。

english_guide.finding: Transient Coulomb crystallization can emerge in freely propagating electron pulses without external trapping: leading and trailing electrons create a self-induced longitudinal potential that transiently confines inner particles into an ordered chain.
english_guide.question: Can repulsive interactions order like-charged particles in freely propagating electron pulses without spatial confinement, and how does this ordering evolve with particle number?
english_guide.evidence: Number-resolved energy correlations measured by transmission electron microscopy in photoemitted pulses containing up to nine electrons show strong correlations at small particle numbers that progressively disappear in the pulse interior as the number increases.
english_guide.method: Transmission electron microscopy measurements of number-resolved energy correlations, combined with many-body simulations and a one-dimensional statistical-mechanical model, yielding a crystallization phase diagram.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that transient crystallization arises in freely propagating electron pulses without external trapping, and theoretically predict spontaneous longitudinal periodic bunching in continuous electron beams under weak transverse guiding.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify pulse generation conditions, energy and time scales, or quantitative experimental uncertainties; crystallization in continuous beams and transverse guiding are theoretical predictions only.

papers.title: Point-contact spectroscopy of electron-phonon interactions and anisotropy of superconducting energy gaps in $2H-NbS{{e}_{2}}$
papers.abstract: The superconducting state of $2H-NbS{{e}_{2}}$ was studied using point contacts for two main orientations of the contact axis relative to the principal crystallographic orientations: along the $c$-axis and in the $ab$ plane. For contacts oriented in the $ab$ plane, dependencies proportional to the electron-phonon interaction function were obtained, which agree perfectly with the theoretical calculation. It was found that the features on the experimental curves associated with the electron-phonon interaction extend to energies twice the cutoff energy of the phonon spectrum and have an amplitude of the same order of magnitude throughout the entire energy range. It has been theoretically demonstrated that the features at energies exceeding the boundaries of the phonon density of states are caused by two-phonon scattering processes of non-equilibrium phonons on Andreev electrons. A criterion for the undisturbed nature of the crystal lattice in the region where gap features form has been found. Using $2H-NbS{{e}_{2}}-Cu$ heterocontacts in the superconducting state, a study of energy gaps was conducted for two orientations of the $NbS{e_2}$ crystal: along the $c$-axis and in the $ab$ plane. It was found that the superconducting energy gaps are anisotropic; specifically, three gaps were identified in the $ab$ plane, whereas only two were observed in the $c$ direction.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验与理论结合；点接触谱测量并辅以理论计算；研究对象：2H-NbSe2超导体，点接触方向沿c轴和ab面
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 2H-NbSe2超导能隙各向异性：ab面识别出三个能隙，c方向仅两个；电子-声子作用特征延伸至声子谱截止能量两倍。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：研究2H-NbSe2中电子-声子相互作用谱与超导能隙的各向异性，并解释超出声子谱边界的谱特征来源。
证据与比较：ab面点接触谱与理论计算吻合；电子-声子特征延伸至声子谱截止能量两倍且幅度同量级；理论表明超出声子态密度边界的特征源于非平衡声子在Andreev电子上的双声子散射；2H-NbSe2-Cu异质结中ab面三个能隙、c方向两个。
papers.method_zh: 沿c轴和ab面取向的点接触谱；2H-NbSe2-Cu异质结测量能隙；理论计算电子-声子相互作用函数。

papers.title: Hydrodynamic fluctuations in Luttinger liquids
papers.abstract: We develop the theory of hydrodynamic fluctuations for one-dimensional quantum liquids. At low temperatures the relaxation of interacting electrons in a single-channel wire separates into two classes: equilibration, which changes the numbers of right and left movers through backscattering and is exponentially slow, and thermalization, which redistributes energy and momentum at a fixed number of movers at a power-law rate. This separation of time scales gives the electron liquid a two-fluid description analogous to superfluid $^4$He, with the zero mode of the Luttinger liquid as the superfluid component and the gas of thermal excitations as the normal component. Using Onsager reciprocity and the fluctuation-dissipation theorem, we add Langevin fluxes to the two-fluid hydrodynamic equations, including a mutual-friction noise generated by rare backscattering events that has no counterpart in helium. We apply the theory to Coulomb-coupled quantum wires and calculate the dynamic structure factors, which contain a second-sound peak next to the plasmon doublet; the Coulomb drag resistivity, where intrawire equilibration acts as a bottleneck and turns the hydrodynamic drag into an activated temperature dependence; and the near-field heat transfer between the wires. Mode frequencies, spectral weights, linewidths, and the crossover scales of the transport coefficients are expressed through the thermodynamic properties of the liquid and a few dissipative coefficients, providing spectroscopic and transport probes of two-fluid behavior in one-dimensional quantum systems.

papers.title: Perfect sampling of Ising spin glasses with bounding chains
papers.abstract: We study perfect sampling algorithms for Ising spin glasses based on coupling from the past and bounding chains, on several graph families and coupling distributions. For the single-site bounding chain, we establish coalescence in $O(n\log n)$ updates under Dobrushin conditions. On sparse random graphs, our numerical results suggest that efficient sampling extends throughout the tree-uniqueness regime, with a slowdown beyond this threshold. On Erdős-Rényi random graphs $\mathcal{G}(n,d/n)$ with standard Gaussian couplings, we introduce a block bounding chain and prove its coalescence in $O(n\log n)$ block updates in the tree-uniqueness regime for sufficiently large $d$, each block update requiring $O(n)$ operations, adapting a proof in~\cite{Efthymiou_Zampetakis_2024} for the rapid mixing of block Glauber dynamics. On periodic lattices, our experiments instead suggest that the single-site bounding chain is limited by the looseness of its bounding envelope, whereas on the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick model, slow coalescence is accompanied by damage spreading at every inverse temperature tested. These observations motivate alternative bounding representations and couplings as strategies to improve perfect sampling on spin glasses.

papers.title: Enhancing magneto-optical coupling and scattering from magnetic vortices by optical polarization texturing
papers.abstract: Magnetic textures offer a route toward photonic functionality in which electromagnetic fields are controlled not only by material composition and geometry but also by the internal magnetic configuration. Conversely, spatial texturing of these fields is a qualitatively new tool to increase the effective coupling strength to magnetic matter and to act on the the vortex topology and magnetic dynamics. Here, we investigate the coupling and scattering of structured electromagnetic fields by a magnetic vortex, focusing on how spatially non-collinear magnetization governs polarization conversion, electromagnetic energy flow, and magnetization dynamics. We develop a spherical rigorous coupled-wave method that incorporates the spatially dependent anisotropic magnetic permeability associated with the vortex texture. The calculations show that the off-diagonal components of the magnetic susceptibility mediate conversion into complementary polarization channels that are absent from the incident field. The generated fields exhibit pronounced spatial localization associated with the vortex magnetization profile and support a nonzero azimuthal component of electromagnetic energy flow. A comparison between linearly and radially polarized illumination reveals an approximately one-order-of-magnitude difference in the scattered fields amplitudes due to polarization texturing, demonstrating the importance of spatial overlap between the incident field and the anisotropic magnetic response. The back-action on the magnetic vortex dynamics is quantitatively demonstrated by numerical simulations for the inverse Faraday effect due to the rectification of structured effective-field excitation. It is shown that polarization textured optical fields can drive vortex-core precession and, at sufficiently strong excitation, reverse the core polarity and chirality on nanosecond time scale.

papers.title: Magnetic crystal generation with site-resolved magnetic moments via Gaussian-mixture retargeting and finite-budget yield prediction
papers.abstract: We introduce GMMag, a workflow for generating crystal structures together with their site-resolved magnetic moments, built on a conditional variational autoencoder with a graph neural network encoder and a transformer decoder. Gaussian-mixture sampling redirects generation towards selected chemical and magnetic targets without retraining. We systematically investigate how encoder and decoder design, the representation of magnetic-moment magnitudes and relative signs, and sampling choices affect reconstruction, generation quality and diversity. Because a higher screening pass rate does not necessarily yield more qualifying candidates with distinct chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, we model how repeated generation of the same chemical formulas limits their accumulation and test the model in two separate ten-million-draw runs. As an application, the workflow identifies Nd-containing candidates with chemical formulas absent from the reference dataset, negative formation energies and high estimated saturation magnetization.

papers.title: Phase Separation in a Mixture System of Active and Passive Particles
papers.abstract: We carried out molecular dynamics simulations of a mixture of self-propelled particles (SPPs) and passive particles. When the self-propulsion speed was sufficiently high, the system separated into two phases. One phase consists of ordered passive particles, and the other is a disordered mixture of both particle types. The separation arises from the interplay between the self-propelled motion of SPPs and thermal motion of the passive particles, since phase separation does not appear with either particle type alone. As the self-propulsion speed increases, the SPPs push surrounding particles away, effectively increasing their excluded size. As a result, the increase in the effective excluded sizes promotes the accumulation of passive particles and the segregation of SPPs into the dilute phase through a mechanism analogous to the depletion interaction. This mechanism explains the phase separation observed in the present study. Our findings provide insights into the potential applications of SPPs and contribute to our understanding of natural systems composed of elements with different levels of motility.

papers.title: Reconstructing chiral edge states via boundary dissipation
papers.abstract: Boundary dissipation can reshape the spatial profiles and decay properties of topological edge modes in Chern insulators. We develop a microscopic boundary-channel framework to explain their decay mechanisms and determine the effective decay rates in the weak- and strong-loss regimes. By retaining the lossy outer orbitals and a normalized edge state of the Hermitian inner system, we identify a directly coupled bright boundary channel, while incorporating the remaining inner states through a Feshbach self-energy. In the Qi--Wu--Zhang model, weak-loss decay is governed to leading order by the original edge state's probability weight on the lossy boundary, with coupling-induced corrections starting at cubic order. At strong loss, the reconstructed inner-edge state instead decays through virtual coupling to the damped bright channel, giving a rate proportional to the squared microscopic coupling and inversely proportional to the bare loss. The Haldane model shows that the same leading decay mechanism holds for a different intercell hopping structure, while additional matrix-valued self-energy feedback modifies the boundary spectrum at finite loss and shifts the exceptional-point threshold. These results provide a unified microscopic description of boundary-state reconstruction and its decay mechanisms, offering testable predictions to guide experiments in photonic crystals, phononic crystals, and topolectrical circuits.

papers.title: Cu intercalation and field-driven filament formation in vertically aligned MoS$_2$ memristors
papers.abstract: Vertically-aligned MoS$_2$ films paired with a Cu top electrode have been used as electrochemical metallization cell memristor devices. The memristive switching has been attributed to the formation of conductive filaments, yet their exact structure has remained elusive. Here we carry out a multi-scale computational study of Cu intercalation, clustering, and field-driven dynamics to eventually model the filament formation under operating conditions. We use density-functional theory results to fine-tune a machine learning force field, and the most important physical phenomena are further distilled into multi-particle kinetic Monte Carlo simulations. By exhaustive enumeration of Cu intercalated structures, we find the most stable structure at MoS$_2$Cu$_{0.11}$ composition, with Cu atoms forming a dice lattice between the MoS$_2$ layers. These structures are shown to exhibit metallic character and can thus form conductive filaments under memristor operation. The simulated switching speed and threshold voltage agree well with the available experimental data. Our results give fundamental insights on the device operation mechanism and guidelines for maximizing switching speed and endurance.

papers.title: Langevin dynamics towards Generalized Gibbs Ensembles
papers.abstract: In recent years, statistical physics tools have been used to study the dynamics of macroscopic quantum and classical integrable models. These studies have shown that, in the thermodynamic limit, long term time-averages of local observables equal statistical averages calculated with a Generalized Gibbs Ensemble (GGE). In the latter, the weight in phase space involves all constants of motion multiplied by Lagrange multipliers which are fixed by their initial values. We argue that the GGE can be interpreted as a proper Boltzmann measure of a different (non-standard) mechanical model. This measure can therefore be sampled with stochastic methods implemented, for example, as a Langevin process. We tailor the deterministic force in the Langevin equations so that at long times the stochastic trajectories sample the desired measure. We use the integrable Neumann Model -- the model of a classical particle constrained to move on a sphere under anisotropic harmonic potentials -- as a benchmark. We test the method in a setup where the Lagrange multipliers are fixed by the GGE governing the asymptotic dynamics of the isolated Neumann model following a quench. This problem has different phases depending on the initial conditions and quench protocol and, in all cases, with the stochastic evolution of an adequately tuned Langevin process we reproduce the asymptotic values of relevant observables.

papers.title: First-Principles Investigation of Irida-Graphane: A Wide-Band-Gap Semiconductor Derived from Irida-Graphene
papers.abstract: Opening a band gap in metallic two-dimensional carbon allotropes is an important step toward their use in electronic and optoelectronic devices, and full hydrogenation has proven to be an effective route to achieve it. Here, we propose irida-graphane, the fully hydrogenated derivative of the irida-graphene, a monolayer composed of three-, six-, and eight-membered rings, and investigate its structural, mechanical, electronic, and optical properties using density functional theory (DFT) at the PBE and HSE06 levels combined with phonon and \textit{ab initio} molecular dynamics (AIMD) simulations. All carbon atoms adopt $sp^3$ hybridization, with the hydrogen atoms of the three- and six-membered rings bonded to opposite sides of a buckled carbon framework, and the lattice parameter contracts by 4.3% with respect to irida-graphene. The hydrogenation energy of $-0.53$ eV/H indicates that the hydrogenation of irida-graphene from molecular hydrogen is exothermic. The absence of imaginary phonon frequencies confirms the dynamical stability of irida-graphane, and AIMD simulations show that its structure remains intact at temperatures up to 2000 K. Irida-graphane is mechanically isotropic, with an in-plane stiffness of approximately 156 N/m, a Poisson's ratio of approximately 0.1, and critical strains of approximately 20%. Hydrogenation transforms the metallic parent structure into a semiconductor with an indirect band gap of 4.68 eV (PBE) and 6.0 eV (HSE06). Irida-graphane is transparent in the visible range, with reflectivity below 0.3%, and absorbs strongly in the deep ultraviolet, with absorption coefficients of the order of $10^{5} - 10^{6}$ cm$^{-1}$. These results suggest irida-graphane as a candidate wide-gap material for ultraviolet optoelectronics and transparent coatings.

papers.title: Transport statistics in asymmetric coupled chaotic dots in series: Brownian motion model
papers.abstract: We study statistics of transport properties in a system of two quantum chaotic cavities coupled in series through a tunable junction and connected to reservoirs with asymmetric leads. Within the random matrix theory framework and in the absence of time-reversal symmetry, the scattering matrix S undergoes a crossover from two independent circular unitary ensembles to a single CUE as the inter-cavity coupling increases. Modeling this crossover using Dyson's Brownian motion approach, with the junction width acting as a time-like parameter, we derive closed-form expressions for the time-dependent averages and variances of conductance and shot noise power for arbitrary lead asymmetry. These analytical results reduce to known expressions in the symmetric and fully coupled limits. The mapping between the Brownian time parameter and the physical junction width is found to be observable-dependent, reflecting the different eigenfunction correlations probed by conductance and shot noise power, and this dependence is examined and separately calibrated for each observable. Validating against random-matrix simulations and tight-binding transport calculations using Kwant, we find quantitative agreement for ensemble-averaged observables throughout the crossover, while variances, being more sensitive to microscopic fluctuations, show deviations from the Brownian-motion predictions.

papers.title: Perimeter shell properties of branched polymer adsorbents in various conformational states
papers.abstract: The structural accessibility and perimeter shell properties of branched macromolecules are studied using Monte Carlo simulations on a simple cubic lattice. Constituent polymer chains of these macromolecules are constructed in an algorithmic way as: a set of collinear monomers; a self-avoiding walk (SAW); tigthly packed monomers. These mimic the ground states for a rigid rod, flexible chain, and collapsed chain conformational states, respectively. We analyzed the set of observables that are related to adsorption, such as perimeter shell size (number of available sites for particle adsorption) per monomer $\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$, mean coordination number of perimeter shell $\langle n_{\rm bond} \rangle$ (average number of contacts per adsorbed particle), and coordination accessibility per monomer $\langle \bar{n}_s \rangle$. Our results demonstrate that branching reduces the perimeter shell size while it increases mean coordination number of perimeter shell across all conformational states, due to higher local monomer density near branching cores and formation of shared adsorption sites or microcages. Stiff extended structures yield the highest values for $\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ (approaching $4$ in the limit of long chains), whereas the flexible ones provide the largest values for $\langle n_{\rm bond} \rangle$. We can note that the collinearity of monomers in constituent chains works in the same direction as reduction of branching ($\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ grows), whereas the { tight packing of them} -- in the same direction as the increase of branching ($\langle \bar{n}_a \rangle$ decreases)

papers.title: Two Exceptional-Point Regimes in the Spinterface Model of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity
papers.abstract: The spinterface model of chirality-induced spin selectivity supports two algebraically distinct near-exceptional-point (EP) regimes, which cannot be mixed. A \emph{gold-level} near-EP involves the two gold spin states under an anti-Hermitian, electrode-mediated spin flip with spin-symmetric dissipative broadening (Scheme~B). A \emph{chain-level} near-EP involves the collective coalescence of the two molecular eigenstates with largest weight on the first molecular site under a Hermitian on-site Rashba spin flip with spin-dependent broadening (Scheme~A). Mixing the diagonal cancellation of one scheme with the off-diagonal structure of the other yields a strictly negative discriminant and admits no EP on any parameter path, making the gold/chain classification exhaustive. At the gold near-EP the spin-flip coupling is chirality-selective, converting achiral spin-valve transport into purely chiral transport across well-defined crossover points. At the chain near-EP the Petermann factor grows as a power law in chain length, with an exponent tunable by the Rashba coherence length and non-monotonic in the Rashba strength, reflecting a balance between coherent enhancement and progressive breakdown of the Scheme-A condition. Both near-EPs are dressed versions of the ideal two-state EP, and the ratio between observed and bare EP locations measures the delocalisation of the coalescing pair, providing a fit-free diagnostic of the mechanism. These results identify CISS junctions as a solid-state platform for non-Hermitian spectral physics.

papers.title: Residual dynamics determine dissipation in strongly coupled linear Langevin systems
papers.abstract: Interactions shape the properties of many physical and biological nonequilibrium systems, but whether collective operation raises or lowers entropy production remains difficult to predict. Here, we show that strong coupling suppresses irreversible circulation associated with the directly coupled degrees of freedom. In identical two-dimensional systems, this suppression is monotonic for nonzero coupling modes and guarantees a monotonic decrease of the entropy production rate (EPR), with the corresponding probability currents vanishing in the strong-coupling limit. In higher dimensions, suppressing the circulation associated with the coupled degrees of freedom does not generally eliminate all irreversible circulation, since the remaining degrees of freedom can still sustain nonequilibrium currents. The EPR of these residual dynamics sets the strong-coupling limit, providing a criterion for whether a given choice of coupled variables leads to lower dissipation than the uncoupled system. The approach to this limit depends on how the finite-coupling current correction aligns with the residual current. Further, we show that convergence to residual dynamics in the strong-coupling limit also applies to coupled non-identical systems. Finally, we demonstrate the predicted EPR reduction in nonlinear models of vertebrate hair-cell bundles and bacterial chemotaxis.

papers.title: Prussian blue and Prussian white thin-film electrodes: Single-step electrodeposition for anode and cathode applications
papers.abstract: This study examines how deposition potential influences the composition and nanoscale structure of Prussian Blue (PB)/Prussian White (PW)-family films, providing an experimental basis for assessing their proposed functions. Films were grown directly on Au/Cr/Si in a single potentiostatic step from a common aqueous bath at $-0.20$ to $+0.40$\,V versus a saturated calomel electrode, with a fixed deposition charge of 10\,mC. Electron microscopy, elemental analysis, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy, and Raman spectroscopy revealed potential-dependent chemistry and nonmonotonic morphology. EDS indicated greater K incorporation in lower-potential deposits, whose Fe~2p and Raman features were consistent with more reduced, PW-like environments. Surface K/Fe ratios varied nonmonotonically from 1.129 to 1.322 across the series, corresponding to 52.95--56.94\% K within the detected K+Fe population. Larger faceted crystallites at $+0.30$\,V contrasted with finer pyramids and cracks at $+0.40$\,V. Selected PB-like and PW-like regions had local cubic lattice parameters of $(10.31\pm0.10)$\,Å and $(10.36\pm0.10)$\,Å, respectively; their overlapping uncertainties prevent discrimination by lattice spacing alone. Cross-sectional maps showed broadly uniform framework-element distributions within locally continuous coatings. Together, these observations relate deposition conditions to contrasting chemical and morphological starting states without establishing bulk stoichiometry or phase purity. A literature-grounded outlook identifies ion storage, sensing, electrochromism, resistive switching, and ion handling as research opportunities requiring functional validation in these films.

papers.title: The constrained molecular dynamics (CMD) to obtain spatio-temporal memory functions of viscoelastic liquids: stability analysis of equations of motion
papers.abstract: Mechanical stress is one of the main characteristics of viscoelastic molecular systems, including vitrifying liquids and amorphous solids which are known to show long-range dynamical heterogeneities. It is therefore important to deal with time- and space-resolved local stress whose correlations can be used to obtain viscoelastic memory functions of such systems, in particular, their wave-vector dependent shear and compression relaxation moduli. However, such memory functions are not directly accessible within standard molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. Here we discuss a new method called the constrained molecular dynamics (CMD) which allows for a direct evaluation of the wave-vector and time dependent viscoelastic moduli. The study is focused, in particular, on the stability analysis of different variants of the CMD, revealing the most efficient stabilization algorithm. Our theoretical predictions for the time-dependence of the most important parameters (like the wave-vector resolved mass current) during the stabilization stage are compared with the simulation data using different CMD algorithms. An excellent agreement is observed, thus confirming the validity of our theoretical approach and its ability to accurately predict the most important initial part of CMD trajectories.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论结合模拟；摘要含稳定性理论预测与模拟数据对比；研究对象：粘弹性分子体系，包括玻璃化液体与非晶固体；波矢与时间依赖的粘弹性模量

papers.title: Spin-Orbit-Torque-Driven Recurrent Motion of Synthetic Antiferromagnetic Skyrmions for Magnetic Clocking
papers.abstract: Magnetic skyrmions in synthetic antiferromagnets have emerged as attractive information carriers for spintronic technologies due to their compensated topology, which mitigates the skyrmion Hall effect and facilitates reliable current-driven transport. Here we present a frequency-tunable magnetic clocking concept based on the recurring translational motion of SAF skyrmions and define the material conditions needed to realize it in a Pt/Co/Ru/Pt/Co multilayer. Using micromagnetic simulations, we investigate the combined effects of interfacial Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction and interlayer Ruderman-Kittel-Kasuya-Yosida exchange coupling, delineating the parameter space in which coupled Néel-type skyrmions with opposite topological charges form a stable, topologically compensated pair. Under spin-orbit torque excitation, the SAF skyrmions exhibit resilient longitudinal transport with minimal transverse deflection using periodic boundary conditions. Periodic boundary conditions serve as an idealized model for closed-loop racetrack geometries, facilitating the study of continuous transport cycles and long-range steady-state dynamics. The oscillation frequency is readily modified by the applied current density and material characteristics, offering a pathway to field-free nanoscale timing components. Moreover, the threshold-activated initiation of recurrent transport mimics tonic-spiking behavior, indicating possible use in neuromorphic signal generation. This work establishes SAF skyrmions as versatile building elements for future spintronic functional devices by integrating topological protection, controllable transport, and cyclic dynamics.

papers.title: Spontaneous topological diode effect induced by non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order
papers.abstract: In non-centrosymmetric bulk materials, electrons flowing in the opposite directions often exhibit different properties. This diode-like effect (i.e., non-reciprocal electron transport) typically originates from relativistic spin-orbit coupling, and its amplitude scales with external magnetic field or magnetization in ferromagnets. Although such rectification is usually absent in antiferromagnets at zero field, recent theories predict that non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order can host large non-reciprocity even without spin-orbit coupling, magnetization or external magnetic fields. This phenomenon - the spontaneous topological diode effect - can potentially be used for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, while it has not been verified for real materials. Here, we report the observation of this effect in a chiral-lattice non-coplanar antiferromagnet CoTa3S6. Nonlinear resistivity measurements reveal the non reciprocal nature of electron transport along the [001] direction at zero field. The observed non-reciprocity exceeds that in typical ferromagnets, whose amplitude is governed by antiferromagnetic order parameter rather than magnetization. First-principles calculations show that the non-coplanar antiferromagnetic order induces asymmetric band dispersions even without spin-orbit coupling, establishing the non-relativistic origin of the observed response. The present findings demonstrate a new mechanism for efficient electrical readout of antiferromagnetic domains, and highlight non-coplanar antiferromagnets as a promising material platform for realizing ferromagnet-like functional responses without relying on spin-orbit coupling or magnetization.

papers.title: Structural supermodulation enables resonant Raman determination of crystalline orientation in Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x flakes
papers.abstract: Bi2Sr2CaCu2O8+x (Bi-2212) is a d-wave superconductor with unconventional properties intrinsic to the material itself. These properties are of growing interest for quantum technologies in electronics and photonics, and twisted Josephson junctions can make direct use of them. However, Bi-2212 is strongly anisotropic, and it is challenging to find its crystal axes in flakes in advance, which limits device engineering. Here, we show that polarized resonant Raman spectroscopy reveals the orientation of both the a and b axes of Bi-2212 optically and non-destructively. By correlating Laue diffraction, HAADF-STEM and polarized Raman scattering on the same bulk crystal, we assign the b axis, along which the incommensurate structural supermodulation propagates, to the intensity maximum of the 27 cm-1 supermodulation mode, which varies in counter-phase with the 118 cm-1 Bi/Sr mode, along the a axis. Multi-wavelength measurements (458, 532, 660 nm) show that resulting in-plane contrast peaks at 532 nm and nearly vanishes at 660 nm, indicating that the anisotropy originates from an electronic resonance induced by the supermodulation. Using this resonance, we determine the crystallographic axes of exfoliated flakes and access their symmetry channels, providing a rapid orientation tool for cuprate van der Waals heterostructures.

papers.title: Impurity-induced trimer formation across the BCS-BEC crossover
papers.abstract: By means of diffusion Monte Carlo calculations, we study the behavior of a single impurity embedded in two balanced Fermi baths across the BCS-BEC crossover. The impurity interacts attractively with both baths through Pöschl-Teller potentials of different strengths. That interaction is such that does not support an impurity--bath two-body bound state. When that attraction is sufficiently strong, we observe the formation of trimers composed of the impurity and one atom from each bath. These clusters are Borromean on the BCS side, where no two-body subsystem is bound, and evolve continuously into tango-like trimers on the BEC side. Subtracting from the total energy the binding energy of one trimer and that of the remaining bath-bath dimers restores the equation of state of the impurity-free system, supporting a dilute-cluster interpretation. The analysis of interparticle distances shows that the embedded trimer is not simply a dimer dressed by the impurity, but a genuine three-body cluster formed inside the two Fermi baths.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；采用扩散蒙特卡罗（diffusion Monte Carlo）数值计算；研究对象：嵌入两个平衡费米浴（Fermi baths）中的单个杂质，跨越 BCS-BEC 渡越（crossover）

papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：在杂质—浴相互作用不支持两体束缚态的前提下，单个杂质嵌入两个平衡费米浴后能否形成三体团簇，以及该团簇在 BCS-BEC 渡越两侧的性质如何变化。
证据与比较：从总能量中减去一个 trimer 的结合能与剩余 bath-bath dimers 的能量后，可恢复无杂质体系的状态方程（equation of state），支持稀薄团簇解释；粒子间距离分析表明嵌入的 trimer 并非杂质修饰的 dimer，而是真正的三体团簇。
papers.method_zh: 扩散蒙特卡罗（diffusion Monte Carlo）计算；杂质通过不同强度的 Pöschl-Teller 势与两个费米浴吸引相互作用。

english_guide.finding: A single impurity embedded in two balanced Fermi baths across the BCS-BEC crossover forms trimers consisting of the impurity and one atom from each bath when the attraction is sufficiently strong; these clusters are Borromean on the BCS side and evolve continuously into tango-like trimers on the BEC side.
english_guide.question: Whether a single impurity embedded in two balanced Fermi baths can form three-body clusters when the impurity-bath interaction does not support a two-body bound state, and how such clusters behave across the BCS-BEC crossover.
english_guide.evidence: Subtracting the binding energy of one trimer and that of the remaining bath-bath dimers from the total energy restores the equation of state of the impurity-free system, supporting a dilute-cluster interpretation; interparticle-distance analysis shows the embedded trimer is not simply a dimer dressed by the impurity but a genuine three-body cluster.
english_guide.method: Diffusion Monte Carlo calculations; the impurity interacts attractively with both baths through Pöschl-Teller potentials of different strengths.
english_guide.novelty: The authors report observing impurity-induced trimer formation that is Borromean on the BCS side and evolves into tango-like trimers on the BEC side, arguing it is a genuine three-body cluster rather than a dimer dressed by the impurity.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify parameter ranges, finite-size effects, or computational uncertainties; the interaction is a Pöschl-Teller potential that does not support an impurity-bath two-body bound state, and the scope of validity is not stated.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者在摘要中表述：观察到杂质诱导的 trimer 形成，其在 BCS 侧为 Borromean、在 BEC 侧演化为 tango-like，并论证其为真正的三体团簇而非杂质修饰的 dimer。
papers.limitations_zh: 摘要未明确说明具体参数范围、有限尺寸效应与计算误差；相互作用取为不支持杂质—浴两体束缚态的 Pöschl-Teller 势，结论的适用范围摘要未明确说明。

papers.title: The role of A in ARPES
papers.abstract: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) was developed in the 1970s-1990s as a momentum-resolved probe of the electronic structure of solids, with its basic principles summarized in early seminal works and classic reviews. The basic ARPES result is currently almost exclusively associated with the two-dimensional intensity distribution with coordinate axes labeled as Binding Energy and Momentum. Such datasets are usually directly compared to the band structure calculations along high symmetry directions of the Brillouin zone. Here we show that this is the result of an oversimplified treatment of the ARPES data leading to incorrect interpretations of the experimental results. We suggest practical ways of how to avoid it in both data collection and analysis.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：方法学/评论性分析；基于对ARPES数据处理惯例的批判性讨论；研究对象：角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）数据及其与能带结构计算的对比
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 将ARPES数据简化为结合能与动量的二维强度分布并直接对比高对称方向能带计算，是对数据的过度简化处理，会导致对实验结果的错误解读。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：ARPES数据当前普遍采用的二维强度分布呈现与直接对比能带计算的做法，是否会误导对实验结果的解释，以及如何在数据采集与分析中避免。
证据与比较：摘要为方法学论述，未提供具体测量数据、对照实验或定量比较；仅指出基本ARPES结果目前几乎只以结合能-动量二维强度分布呈现，并称该做法源于过度简化的处理。
papers.method_zh: 对ARPES数据呈现与解释惯例进行批判性分析，并提出在数据采集和分析中避免过度简化的实用建议；摘要未给出具体方案细节。

english_guide.finding: Treating ARPES data as a two-dimensional intensity distribution labeled by binding energy and momentum, and directly comparing it with band-structure calculations along high-symmetry directions, is an oversimplified treatment that can lead to incorrect interpretations of experimental results.
english_guide.question: Whether the prevailing presentation of basic ARPES results as two-dimensional intensity maps and their direct comparison with band-structure calculations misleads interpretation, and how to avoid this in data collection and analysis.
english_guide.evidence: The abstract is a methodological critique and provides no specific measurements, controlled comparisons, or quantitative evidence; it states that basic ARPES results are currently almost exclusively associated with two-dimensional intensity distributions with axes labeled Binding Energy and Momentum.
english_guide.method: Critical analysis of ARPES data presentation and interpretation conventions, with suggested practical ways to avoid oversimplification in both data collection and analysis; details are not specified in the abstract.

papers.title: Replica Analysis of Overfitting in Vector Generalized Linear Models
papers.abstract: We show how the successful recent statistical physics based theory of overfitting in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) can be generalized to a much larger family of regression models: the so-called Vector Generalized Linear Models (VGLMs), in which not a single linear combination of covariates drives the outcome, but where one has an arbitrary finite number of such linear combinations. The latter more general and complex models can describe more sophisticated statistical patterns in data, but are even more prone to overfitting than GLMs due to their significantly larger number of parameters; this often limits their use. We show that the generalization of the overfitting theory from GLMs to VGLMs causes many mathematical challenges that were absent from the earlier work, mostly related to the increased dimensional complexity of all order parameters in the theory, but that the new problem is once more solvable using the replica method. This opens up the field to many novel and welcome applications, especially in post-genome medical inference and data analysis, where overfitting is and remains a major barrier to progress. After developing the general VGLM overfitting theory, within the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz, we illustrate its merits and its correctness via application to several relevant VGLM regression models.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于统计物理复制法（replica method）的解析推导；研究对象：向量广义线性模型（Vector Generalized Linear Models, VGLMs）的过拟合问题
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 作者将广义线性模型（GLMs）的过拟合统计物理理论推广到VGLMs，并在复制对称（replica symmetric, RS）假设下给出可解的新理论。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何把已有的GLM过拟合统计物理理论推广到含任意有限个协变量线性组合的VGLMs，并处理由此带来的数学困难？
证据与比较：摘要称新理论在RS拟设下通过若干相关VGLM回归模型的应用来展示其有效性与正确性，但未给出具体测量、数值比较或定量结果。
papers.method_zh: 使用复制法（replica method），在复制对称（RS）拟设下解析推导VGLM过拟合理论，并应用于若干VGLM回归模型。

english_guide.finding: The statistical-physics theory of overfitting in Generalized Linear Models (GLMs) is generalized to Vector Generalized Linear Models (VGLMs), where an arbitrary finite number of linear combinations of covariates drives the outcome; the new problem is solvable via the replica method within the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz.
english_guide.question: How can the existing statistical-physics theory of overfitting in GLMs be extended to VGLMs, which are more prone to overfitting due to a significantly larger number of parameters, and what mathematical challenges arise?
english_guide.evidence: The abstract states that the merits and correctness of the general VGLM overfitting theory are illustrated via application to several relevant VGLM regression models, but no specific measurements, numerical comparisons, or quantitative results are provided.
english_guide.method: Replica method; analytical derivation of the general VGLM overfitting theory within the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz, applied to several relevant VGLM regression models.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that generalizing the overfitting theory from GLMs to VGLMs causes many mathematical challenges absent from earlier work, mostly related to the increased dimensional complexity of all order parameters, but the new problem is once more solvable using the replica method.
english_guide.limitations: The theory is restricted to the replica symmetric (RS) ansatz; the abstract does not specify model settings, scope of applicability, or quantitative validation details.

papers.title: ZnO/Ni interface-activated enhancement of spintronic terahertz emission from Ni/Pt bilayers
papers.abstract: Spintronic terahertz (THz) emitters based on ferromagnet/heavy-metal bilayers provide an efficient route for generating broadband THz radiation through ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. However, Ni/Pt bilayers usually exhibit relatively weak THz emission, limiting their use as efficient spintronic emitters. Here, we report an interface-assisted enhancement of THz emission in ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures. By placing ZnO underneath Ni while preserving the direct Ni/Pt contact, the THz amplitude is increased by up to approximately 2.8 times compared with the Ni/Pt reference. The enhanced emission reverses polarity with the magnetic field and follows the expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion. ZnO-, Ni-, and Pt-thickness-dependent measurements show that the emission remains governed by the Ni/Pt conversion process but is strongly affected by the ZnO/Ni bottom interface. Control samples with Al2O3, Cu, and Fe further exclude a simple underlayer, optical, or growth-quality origin. The enhancement is attributed to a short-range ZnO/Ni interface effect, possibly involving oxygen-related defects, interfacial electric fields, and modification of the Ni interfacial state. This work provides a semiconductor/ferromagnet interface-engineering strategy for activating weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；基于ZnO/Ni/Pt异质结的THz发射测量与对照样品比较；研究对象：ZnO/Ni/Pt异质结构，以及Ni/Pt、Al2O3/Ni/Pt、Cu/Ni/Pt、Fe/Ni/Pt对照样品
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在保持Ni/Pt直接接触的前提下于Ni下方插入ZnO，可使Ni/Pt的THz振幅最高提升约2.8倍，该增强源于短程ZnO/Ni界面效应。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何激活通常THz发射较弱的Ni/Pt自旋电子发射器，并判断增强是否来自ZnO/Ni底界面而非其他因素。
证据与比较：THz振幅相对Ni/Pt参考最高约2.8倍；发射极性随磁场反转，角度依赖符合超快自旋-电荷转换；ZnO、Ni、Pt厚度依赖测量；Al2O3、Cu、Fe对照排除简单底層、光学或生长质量起源。
papers.method_zh: 制备ZnO/Ni/Pt及多种对照异质结，进行THz发射测量、磁场极性与角度依赖测量、各层厚度依赖测量。

english_guide.finding: Inserting ZnO beneath Ni while preserving direct Ni/Pt contact enhances THz amplitude by up to approximately 2.8 times versus the Ni/Pt reference.
english_guide.question: How to activate weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters and determine whether enhancement arises from the ZnO/Ni bottom interface.
english_guide.evidence: Up to ~2.8 times THz amplitude; polarity reversal with magnetic field; expected angular dependence of ultrafast spin-to-charge conversion; ZnO-, Ni-, and Pt-thickness dependence; Al2O3, Cu, and Fe controls exclude simple underlayer, optical, or growth-quality origin.
english_guide.method: ZnO/Ni/Pt heterostructures and control samples; THz emission measurements, magnetic-field polarity and angular dependence, layer-thickness-dependent measurements.
english_guide.novelty: The authors propose a semiconductor/ferromagnet interface-engineering strategy for activating weak Ni/Pt spintronic THz emitters.
english_guide.limitations: The enhancement is attributed to a short-range ZnO/Ni interface effect, possibly involving oxygen-related defects, interfacial electric fields, and modification of the Ni interfacial state; quantitative mechanistic evidence and detailed applicability conditions are not provided in the abstract.

papers.novelty_zh: 作者称提出半导体/铁磁体界面工程策略，用于激活弱Ni/Pt自旋电子THz发射器。
papers.limitations_zh: 增强机制仅为归因推测，可能涉及氧相关缺陷、界面电场和Ni界面态改变；摘要未给出定量机制证据或适用条件细节。

papers.title: Spin-polarized tunneling from a Kondo insulator: equilibrium surface magnetism versus magneto-electric response in SmB$_6$
papers.abstract: We theoretically analyze the spin-polarized tunneling between SmB$_6$ tip and the bicollinear antiferromagnet Fe$_{1+x}$Te. The emergence of magnetic contrast in tunneling requires time-reversal symmetry breaking on the surface of the tip. The magnetic contrast part of the tunneling conductance then has two contributions: the first one originates from the magnetic moment due to the equilibrium long-range order on the surface, while the other is governed by the magnetic moment induced by the electric field of the junction through the surface magneto-electric effect. We show that the ratio of the equilibrium moment to the response extracted near zero bias equals, up to the sign, twice the bias at which the contrast changes sign, independently of the relative strength of the two mechanisms, so that this ratio itself does not measure the strength of the magneto-electric effect. We find that within the experimental energy window $|eV|\lesssim10$~meV the {bias-dependent} field-induced contribution is at most a few percent of the equilibrium one, and the two become comparable only at biases of order $100$~meV or higher. The ratio of the field-induced to the equilibrium contribution is inversely proportional to the distance between the tip and the substrate.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于模型分析自旋极化隧穿；研究对象：SmB$_6$ 针尖与双共线反铁磁体 Fe$_{1+x}$Te 之间的隧穿结
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 在零偏压附近，平衡表面磁矩与磁电响应磁矩之比等于磁对比变号偏压的两倍（相差符号），因此该比值本身不能衡量磁电效应强度。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：如何区分 SmB$_6$ 针尖表面平衡长程磁序与表面磁电效应诱导磁矩对自旋极化隧穿磁对比的贡献。
证据与比较：推导出平衡磁矩与响应磁矩之比等于磁对比变号偏压的两倍（相差符号），与两种机制相对强度无关；在 $|eV|\lesssim10$ meV 内场致贡献至多为平衡贡献的百分之几，约 100 meV 或更高偏压时才相当；场致与平衡贡献之比与针尖-衬底距离成反比。
papers.method_zh: 理论分析 SmB$_6$ 针尖与 Fe$_{1+x}$Te 之间的自旋极化隧穿，分解磁对比为平衡表面磁矩与表面磁电响应两项。

english_guide.finding: Near zero bias, the ratio of the equilibrium surface moment to the magneto-electric response equals, up to sign, twice the bias at which the magnetic contrast changes sign, independent of the relative strength of the two mechanisms; hence this ratio does not measure the magneto-electric effect strength.
english_guide.question: How to separate the contributions of equilibrium long-range surface magnetic order and surface magneto-electric response to spin-polarized tunneling contrast between a SmB$_6$ tip and Fe$_{1+x}$Te.
english_guide.evidence: The ratio of equilibrium to response moment equals twice the sign-change bias up to sign, independent of relative strength; within $|eV|\lesssim10$ meV the field-induced contribution is at most a few percent of the equilibrium one, becoming comparable only at biases of order 100 meV or higher; the ratio of field-induced to equilibrium contribution is inversely proportional to tip-substrate distance.
english_guide.method: Theoretical analysis of spin-polarized tunneling between a SmB$_6$ tip and Fe$_{1+x}$Te, decomposing magnetic contrast into equilibrium surface moment and surface magneto-electric response terms.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that the ratio relation is independent of the relative strength of the two mechanisms and that the ratio itself does not measure the magneto-electric effect strength.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify model parameters, tip surface termination, or temperature range; conclusions are theoretical and no experimental verification is provided.

papers.title: Stability reversal, activated escape, and mechanical response of negative-mobility particles
papers.abstract: Understanding the fluctuations and response of particles in potential landscapes is a fundamental problem in nonequilibrium statistical physics. Here, we investigate how negative mobility reshapes the stochastic behavior of a particle moving in a mechanical potential landscape. We consider a one-dimensional overdamped particle subject to additive noise, with mobility that is negative at weak forces and positive at strong forces. In a potential well, negative mobility destabilizes the mechanical potential minimum and produces bimodal localization at two off-center positions. The same stability reversal transforms conventional Kramers escape from a potential well into a two-stage escape process involving an intermediate metastable state. When an additional spatially uniform force is applied, the mechanical perturbation translates rather than tilts the effective double well, yielding a positive response dominated at weak noise by intrawell relaxation, even though slow interwell switching dominates spontaneous positional fluctuations. These findings reveal how negative mobility reshapes the interplay among mechanical landscapes, stochastic stability, and response.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于过阻尼朗之万模型的随机动力学分析；研究对象：一维过阻尼粒子，迁移率在弱力下为负、强力下为正，处于机械势阱中
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 负迁移率使势阱极小值失稳并产生双峰局域化，把常规Kramers逃逸变为经中间亚稳态的两阶段逃逸，且均匀外力平移而非倾斜有效双阱。
papers.main_content_zh:
研究问题：负迁移率如何改变粒子在机械势场中的随机稳定性、逃逸过程与对外力的响应？
证据与比较：摘要给出解析/模型层面的机制论证：势阱中极小值失稳并出现两个偏心局域位置；逃逸呈两阶段并含中间亚稳态；弱噪声下响应由阱内弛豫主导，而自发位置涨落由慢速阱间切换主导。未提供数值或实验数据。
papers.method_zh: 一维过阻尼粒子加性噪声模型，迁移率随力变号；分析势阱稳定性、Kramers逃逸与均匀外力下的有效双阱响应。

english_guide.finding: Negative mobility destabilizes the mechanical potential minimum, producing bimodal localization at two off-center positions, and converts conventional Kramers escape into a two-stage escape via an intermediate metastable state.
english_guide.question: How does negative mobility reshape the stochastic stability, escape, and response of a particle in a mechanical potential landscape?
english_guide.evidence: Model-level mechanistic arguments: destabilized minimum and two off-center localization positions; two-stage escape with an intermediate metastable state; at weak noise, response dominated by intrawell relaxation while spontaneous positional fluctuations are dominated by slow interwell switching. No numerical or experimental data provided.
english_guide.method: One-dimensional overdamped particle with additive noise and force-dependent mobility that is negative at weak forces and positive at strong forces; analysis of potential-well stability, Kramers escape, and effective double-well response under a spatially uniform force.
english_guide.novelty: The authors state that the findings reveal how negative mobility reshapes the interplay among mechanical landscapes, stochastic stability, and response.
english_guide.limitations: The abstract does not specify parameter ranges, noise-strength conditions, or quantitative validation; no experimental or numerical details are provided.

papers.title: HorizON: A Multi-Horizon Deep Operator Network for Property Prediction of Organic Battery Stacks
papers.abstract: Transition-metal-based batteries rely on critical elements such as lithium, cobalt, and nickel. Their extraction creates environmental and supply-chain challenges. Organic electrode materials (OEMs) reduce this reliance and provide broad molecular tunability. However, OEM-based batteries still show limited long-term cycling stability. Their design also requires the joint optimization of coupled metrics such as voltage, specific capacity, capacity retention, and energy density. These metrics depend on the full battery stack and on the interactions among its components rather than on the active material alone. In our previous work, we developed a data-fusion multi-task framework for average discharge voltage and first-cycle specific capacity. Both targets are single-valued. Here, we extend that framework to multi-horizon prediction by predicting a property at every cycle of a discharge trajectory rather than at a single cycle. Our multi-fidelity and Multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learns DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories within one model. We train it on complete battery-stack representations and usage conditions, so it learns battery-stack interactions rather than cathode-only effects. This framework supports long-term property prediction, inverse design, and process optimization for organic battery systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：计算；基于DFT数据训练深度算子网络；研究对象：有机电极材料（OEMs）电池全堆栈体系
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 提出HorizON多视野深度算子网络，可在单一模型中学习DFT氧化还原电位与随循环变化的比容量轨迹，并基于完整电池堆栈表示进行预测。

english_guide.method: Multi-fidelity, multi-horizon Deep Operator Network learning DFT redox potentials and cycle-dependent specific-capacity trajectories from full battery-stack representations and usage conditions.

papers.title: Magnetic Imaging with High Spatial Resolution Using a Single Niobium-Nitride-Based Three-Dimensional Nanobridge Junction
papers.abstract: The nanobridge junctions (NBJs) allow the miniaturization of the Superconducting Quantum Interference Device (SQUID) and improve the spatial resolution of scanning SQUID microscopy. However, the SQUID loop diameter imposed a fundamental limit on the resolution. In this work, we proposed a single niobium-nitride-based three-dimensional nanobridge junction (NbN-3D-NBJ) alternative to the nanoSQUID for high-resolution magnetic imaging. The critical current of an NbN-3D-NBJ showed an nearly monotonic dependence on the external magnetic field, enabling nanoscale mapping of the magnetic field distribution by measuring the junction's critical current with an intrinsic noise level of 100 nT/Hz^1/2. Using a NbN-3D-NBJ probe, we successfully imaged an Abrikosov vortex in a niobium film with a minimal full width at half maxima (FWHM) of 530 nm, constrained by the distance from the junction to the probe tip edge. Furthermore, we resolved 80 nm spacings between the superconducting nanowires utilizing a second probe with an optimized junction-to-tip distance. Thus, the single 3D NbN NBJ probe has been demonstrated as an effective approach for magnetic imaging with ultra-high spatial resolution.

papers.title: Kinetic Sectors and Nonequilibrium Dynamics in the $δ$-Ising Model
papers.abstract: We introduce and analyze the $δ$-Ising model, a kinetic Ising ferromagnet in which single-spin flips are accepted when their energy change does not exceed a tunable threshold. Varying the field and threshold opens or closes local flip channels, dividing parameter space into kinetic sectors, each governed by a fixed Markov transition operator. We prove that the dynamics retains global spin-inversion symmetry exactly when up and down spins have equal numbers of open channels. In one such sector on a periodic chain of length $L$, unbiased random initial states therefore reach the field-aligned and antifield states with probability $1/2$ each. Closing a single channel leaves both states absorbing but makes the probability of ordering against the field decay as $(2/π)^L$. Parameter sweeps correspond to ordered products of sector operators, which separate reaching a state from holding it, so hysteresis appears when a state is reached and released at different sector boundaries. We also show how increasing the system size can induce a Mpemba-like reversal, allowing a state with more misaligned spins to reach the final ordered state sooner on average. On a periodic chain, this reversal arises because the mean absorption time grows logarithmically with system size for many short domains but linearly for a single macroscopic domain, and it disappears when the bulk flip channel is opened. These findings show how a simple, intuitive rule for Ising dynamics links local kinetic constraints to field response, memory, and relaxation within a unified framework.

papers.title: Mixed symmetries in active non-reciprocal systems
papers.abstract: Active materials are driven out of equilibrium at the microscopic scale and display diverse phenomenology; non-reciprocity is a subclass of activity in which action-reaction symmetry is also broken. These models are often grouped by the order of symmetry of their components, such as polar bird flocks or hexatic cellular tissues. However, many biological examples exist in which the components appear to have two or more symmetries simultaneously. To study this effect we introduce two independently controllable symmetries to the non-reciprocal XY model. This lattice model demonstrates wide ranging behavior dictated by the chosen symmetries. We derive a full hydrodynamic description of our lattice model that highlights the mechanisms driving its behavior. Each combination of symmetries can lead to a different hydrodynamic model with one or two simultaneous order parameters with different levels of orientational order that can appear active or not.

papers.title: Stripe antiferromagnetic order and spin dynamics in the Shastry-Sutherland Ising compound Er2Be2GeO7
papers.abstract: In rare-earth compounds, the interplay between geometric frustration and unusual single-ion anisotropy caused by the crystal electric field often leads to exotic magnetic phases. Here, we investigate the magnetic properties of the rare-earth Shastry-Sutherland compound Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ using bulk measurements and neutron scattering down to sub-Kelvin temperatures. A $k=(0,0,0)$ stripe-like antiferromagnetic order with locally tilted Er$^{3+}$ moments is revealed by time-of-flight neutron powder diffraction, accompanied with a $λ$-shape specific-heat anomaly at $T_N=0.84$ K. The temperature dependence of the magnetic peak intensity corresponding to the ordered moment of Er$^{3+}$ approximates to the two-dimensional Ising universality class. Thermal- and cold-neutron inelastic scattering experiments demonstrate that the strong Ising anisotropy originates from the local crystal electric field, and reveal gapped magnetic excitations with weak dispersion in the ordered state. Mean-field random-phase approximation with inequivalent nearest-neighbor couplings accounts well for the collective excitations, while classical Monte Carlo simulations yield the fractional $1/4$ and $1/2$ magnetization plateaus. Our work provides a comprehensive description of the spin correlations in Er$_2$Be$_2$GeO$_7$ with a particular focus on the classical origin of its fractional magnetization plateaus.

papers.title: Real-Space Selection Rule for Moiré Exciton-Phonon Coupling
papers.abstract: Exciton-phonon coupling (ExPC) governs energy relaxation and exciton dynamics in photoexcited quantum materials. Recent advances have revealed rich and tunable excitonic phenomena in moiré superlattices, yet the microscopic mechanisms underlying the coupling between moiré excitons and moiré phonons remain elusive. Here, we develop a real-space representation for moiré ExPC based on a unified theoretical framework combining the many-body Bethe-Salpeter equation with phonon perturbation theory. Furthermore, we uncover a general real-space selection rule: the spatial matching of a moiré exciton's electron and hole densities with the moiré-phonon-induced potential perturbations determines their individual coupling contributions, while coherent interference between the electron and hole contributions controls the total ExPC. We demonstrate this rule in prototypical WSe2/WS2 moiré heterobilayers, revealing pronounced exciton- and phonon-mode-dependent coupling, including nearly complete suppression of ExPC through destructive electron-hole interference. These findings establish the internal electron-hole spatial configuration of moiré excitons as a key degree of freedom governing the strength and mode selectivity of their coupling to moiré phonons, opening opportunities to engineer ExPC through spatially tailored moiré potentials.

papers.title: Charge density-supervised real-space representations for atomistic energy prediction
papers.abstract: Ground-state electron density contains sufficient information to determine ground-state energy, while providing spatial electronic information. This study developed a charge-density-informed graph neural network (hereafter CDGNN) that jointly learns energy and valence electron density from equivariant atomic graphs. This approach incorporates density-supervised real-space probe representations into the global energy regressor, allowing density-related spatial information to contribute to energy prediction. On the QM9 dataset, CDGNN reduced the energy prediction errors relative to an equivariant GNN baseline for interpolation and extrapolation to larger molecules. For small H-containing Fe and Fe-C datasets, CDGNN performed similarly to the baseline, indicating the dataset-dependent benefits of density supervision. CDGNN also accurately predicted the charge density distributions for molecular and Fe-based systems. The attention analysis showed higher weights for probe representations near the H atoms in Fe-based structures. These findings highlight the potential of integrating charge-density information for energy prediction and its task-dependent benefits.

papers.title: Tribocharging of Granular Materials Dictated by Geometric and Thermoelectric Effects
papers.abstract: Tribocharging of granular materials is a widespread phenomenon ranging from volcanic eruptions and dust storms to pharmaceutical processing, yet its underlying mechanism remains elusive. Recent thermoelectric models have provided a quantitative framework for triboelectric charge transfer, but they have difficulty accounting for charging between identical materials. In this Letter, we propose a theory of granular tribocharging based on the interplay between particle geometry and thermoelectric response. Collision-induced frictional heating produces a size-dependent temperature asymmetry between particles, generating a thermoelectric voltage that drives charge transfer. The sign of the Seebeck coefficient determines the charging polarity, while particle size and thermal properties set its magnitude. Our multi-collision theory explains the experimentally observed size- and material-dependent reversal of charging polarity, as in quartz and nylon.

papers.title: Antisymmetric thermopower without magnetism in three-phase composites
papers.abstract: A thermopower that turns a temperature gradient into a perpendicular electric field in every in-plane direction has relied on magnetism. Reciprocity permits it without magnetism, yet under a three-fold or higher axis it vanishes both in reciprocal elastic band transport and in composites of two isotropic phases with ideal interfaces. Here we show that composites of three isotropic phases carry it, and that under such an axis three is the minimum. A third, linearly independent transport matrix escapes the exact two-phase reduction; at weak contrast the first allowed axial term is cubic, proportional to a determinant of the three matrices times material-weighted, handed three-point correlations. Treating the phases as colours identifies the arrangements that allow the response, and crystal nets from reticular chemistry supply printable three-dimensional ones. Certified two-sided bounds give axial Seebeck coefficients of 49.5-50.2 $μ$V K$^{-1}$ in a planar cell and 76-84 $μ$V K$^{-1}$ in a printable woodpile; reflections in planes containing the axis reverse the response, and recolouring 24 nets to restore their parent symmetry switches it off. Around a line heat source the axial driving field has the $1/r$ azimuthal form of the magnetic field of a straight wire and drives circulating currents.

papers.title: Spatial localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts in substitutional Mn-doped Ge: A first-principles study
papers.abstract: Magnetic energy gaps do not reveal the spatial distribution of magnetic-state-dependent atomic forces. We compare ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic forces at identical nuclear positions in 64-site substitutional Mn-doped Ge using collinear PBE calculations. For nearest-neighbour Mn pairs, the radial force projection reverses sign between magnetic branches. In the second-neighbour geometry, the shared Ge neighbour has the largest force contrast, about 2.2 times that of equally near Ge sites coordinated to one Mn. Bridge-displacement gap slopes agree with direct force derivatives across four numerical settings. Tightening the electronic threshold by 100-fold preserves magnetic ordering and the leading site, while the force-contrast vector changes by 1.08% despite a nearly unchanged energy gap. The results identify coordination-associated localization of magnetic-branch force contrasts within the frozen model, without establishing relaxed distortions, full numerical convergence or a unique exchange mechanism.

papers.title: Algebraic flat bands and even central-band Chern numbers in a seven-orbital hopping model
papers.abstract: Turning a flat-band parent into an isolated Chern band requires supervise of destructive interference, hopping phases, and the cell translations of the bonds. We study this connection in a seven-orbital 2 times 2 supercell honeycomb-vacancy lattice, combining analytic reductions with Bloch spectra, lattice Chern invariants, and quantum geometry. The parent lattice has three exact flat branches, a smooth periodic zero mode, and a compact localized state. A uniform gap bound shows that faint intracell-loop hopping preserves two topologically trivial insulating gaps. The intracell hopping graph also admits a staggered chiral coloring: reversing site amplitudes according to this coloring links opposite energies at momenta separated by half a reciprocal period. This constraint restricts the isolated central band to even Chern numbers and forbids a zero-energy insulating filling at every loop phase. Purely imaginary loop hopping admits a real gauge, whereas other phases allow paired band contacts connecting central bands with C3=2 and C3=4. On a specified strong-loop cut, third-order masses open the direct gaps; these gaps shrink faster than the bandwidth as the coupling grows. Changing the bond connectivity to an oriented honeycomb next-nearest-neighbor extension generates a narrower Chern band with nonuniform quantum geometry. These results distinguish individual-band topology from occupied-group topology and reveal how bond connectivity and cell translations determine which topological bands can emerge from an exactly flat parent.

papers.title: Magnon Super-Bloch Oscillations and Switchable Transport in Driven Magnonic Crystals
papers.abstract: Super-Bloch oscillations (SBOs) offer a powerful route to control wave packet propagation in driven lattices, yet their realization in magnonic systems has remained elusive. Here, we predict SBOs of magnon wave packets in periodic magnonic crystals driven by static and ac gradients of magnetic anisotropy field. A static gradient alone induces magnon Bloch oscillation (BO) with a constant carrier frequency. Remarkably, adding a near-resonant MHz-scale ac driving gives rise to a slow large-amplitude envelope oscillation, the hallmark of SBO. At exact resonance, the ac driving enables phase-controlled directional transport with a carrier-frequency shift up to GHz scale. Consequently, the same structure can be switched among three distinct regimes: conventional BO, SBO, and directed transport. Analytical expressions for the oscillation amplitudes, superperiod, drift velocity, and frequency evolution are validated by micromagnetic simulations. Extending to antiferromagnet magnonic crystals, we further demonstrate that these effects drive opposite motions of two oppositely polarized magnon modes in THz range. Our work establishes magnon SBOs as a versatile platform, opening a new avenue for reconfigurable magnonic devices.

papers.title: Intercomponent vortex interaction and dynamics in a uniform Bose quantum liquid
papers.abstract: We investigate the interaction and dynamics of vortices belonging to different components of a binary uniform quantum liquid. Using the coupled extended Gross-Pitaevskii equations with logarithmic beyond-mean-field corrections, we derive the asymptotic interaction potential between well-separated vortices. The interaction potential retains the asymptotic form $s^{-2}$ as a function of the intervortex distance s, but its coefficient depends on the background density through the quantum fluctuation. As a result, the interaction between vortices changes from attractive to repulsive at a critical density. Real-time simulations demonstrate a corresponding reversal of orbital motion of a vortex pair from clockwise to counterclockwise, consistent with their Magnus response.

papers.title: In-situ Control of the Photon-Magnon Synchronized Mode in a Miniaturized Magnetometer
papers.abstract: Photon-magnon synchronized modes (PMSMs) provide a route for magnetic-field sensing by exploiting their enhanced field responsivity due to cusp points (CPs). However, the previous PMSM magnetometer relies on bulky discrete components and lacks in situ control of photon-magnon interactions, limiting its integration and adaptability. Here, we demonstrate a miniaturized PMSM magnetometer integrated on a printed circuit board. A variable resistor is used to tune the photon-magnon coupling strength in situ. By adjusting the variable resistor, the electromagnetic boundary condition of the magnetometer is altered; hence, the reservoir-mediated photon-magnon interaction is changed. The coupling strength shows a non-monotonic dependence on the reflection coefficient adjusted by the variable resistor and reaches its minimum at the impedance matching condition. Furthermore, we develop a non-Hermitian model with standing-wave interference to describe the PMSM dispersion and derive the critical condition for CP formation. This work realizes a compact and tunable PMSM magnetometer and provides a pathway for controlling photon-magnon interactions in integrated magnetic sensing systems.

papers.title: Ground-State Properties of a Lattice-Coupled Strongly Correlated Model for Solid Oxygen under Pressure
papers.abstract: Solid oxygen is an $S=1$ molecular magnet with strong coupling between spin and lattice degrees of freedom. Recent studies suggest that magnetic moments coexist with tetramer distortions under pressure. We derive an effective spin Hamiltonian from a two-orbital Peierls--Hubbard model with spin-orbit coupling. The resulting model contains competing easy-plane single-ion and easy-axis exchange anisotropies. We analyze this model on a square lattice using quantum Monte Carlo simulations and evaluate the magnetic contribution to the lattice stiffness for several lattice distortion patterns including the tetramer pattern. We find that the tetramer pattern is the most favorable among the considered distortion patterns throughout the parameter range studied. Moreover, competition between the two anisotropies enhances the tendency toward lattice distortion and strengthens the preference for tetramerization over the other patterns.

papers.title: Fracture Mechanics and Self-Healing in Molecular Crystal Resonators for Lasing
papers.abstract: Microscale damage poses a significant challenge to the reliability and longevity of miniaturized photonic devices; however, the mechanisms and repair of microscopic cracks and fractures in organic optical crystals remain largely unexplored. Here, we employ a mechanophotonic approach to induce microscale cracks and complete fractures in single crystals of 3-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-one (HDMAC) using an atomic force microscopy (AFM) cantilever tip. We demonstrate the self-healing capability of these crystals while retaining their optical waveguiding and resonator properties, which are essential for lasing applications. HDMAC microcrystals exhibit self-healing of cracks introduced along the (010) and (001) crystallographic planes, demonstrating the versatility of this phenomenon across distinct crystal orientations. Furthermore, we identify different fracture mechanisms and establish a comprehensive assessment of healing efficiency by integrating optical loss measurements, resonator characteristics, and nanomechanical analyses. This multifaceted approach enables fair evaluation of the recovery of structural integrity and photonic functionality following self-healing.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：实验；AFM探针诱导裂纹并测量光学与纳米力学响应；研究对象：有机单晶HDMAC（3-[4-(dimethylamino)phenyl]-1-(2-hydroxyphenyl)prop-2-en-1-one）微晶体谐振器

证据与比较：AFM悬臂探针在HDMAC单晶上诱导微裂纹与完全断裂；沿(010)、(001)晶面均观察到自愈合；以光学损耗测量、谐振腔特性与纳米力学分析综合评估愈合效率。

papers.title: Robustness of Anyonic Time-Domain Interference Against Dephasing
papers.abstract: Recent anyon-collider experiments have identified time-domain braiding (TDB) as a new route to probing anyonic statistics. However, how such time-domain interference responds to environmental noise remains an open question. Here we show that TDB interference is intrinsically more robust than its spatial counterpart. In conventional spatial interference, environmental noise induces phase fluctuations that accumulate throughout all paths, leading to exponential suppression of the interference as the dephasing rate increases. In TDB, by contrast, the interfering temporal paths experience largely overlapping environmental fluctuations, whose contributions cancel out in the relative phase, so that only a small nonoverlapping temporal window contributes to dephasing. As a result, TDB interference decays only algebraically with the dephasing rate, providing a new experimental hallmark for its identification. We propose a Fabry-Perot fractional quantum Hall setup in which both types of interference coexist and experience the same environmental noise, enabling a direct comparison of their dephasing behaviors. Our results establish robustness against dephasing as a fundamental advantage of TDB and suggest new opportunities for exploiting anyonic interference in noisy mesoscopic systems.
papers.study_overview_zh: 研究类型：理论；基于退相位模型分析与干涉路径比较；研究对象：分数量子霍尔体系中的任意子时间域干涉（TDB）与空间干涉
papers.abstract_summary_zh: 时间域编织干涉对环境退相位的内在鲁棒性强于空间干涉，其干涉随退相位速率仅呈代数衰减而非指数抑制。
